title: Fix the Ineffective Synchronization
description: The program should ensure only one thread at a time can execute a critical section, using a shared lock.
expectedBehavior: After both threads finish, total should reliably equal 100000.
actualProblem: synchronized (new Object()) creates a brand-new lock object on every single call, so no two threads ever actually contend for the same lock — the synchronized block provides no real mutual exclusion at all, and updates to total can still be lost.
explanation: synchronized only provides mutual exclusion between threads that lock on the exact same object. A lock object shared across all calls (like a single static final field) is required — creating a fresh lock object per call defeats the purpose entirely.
